description: NSI val4-05: runs below powers of two of t = x*x. R!A1:A8192 are the 8192 doubles just below fl(sqrt(0.5)) = 0.7071067811865476 (t -> 1/2 from below, the end of piece A); R!A8193:A16384 are the 8192 doubles just below 0.5 (t -> 1/4 from below). Each cell is GAMMA.INV(x,0.5,1). Readout: w = SQRT(cell) offline (binary64); no expected values; score raw bits. Precision!B2:B4 must retain 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002; C2:C4 must be -1,0,1. Predictions (hypotheses, NOT oracle values): docs/research/val4-nsi-predictions.json; protocol: docs/research/probe-handoff-2026-11-10-val4-nsi.md.
